[untitled BTM module] These genes read as the secretory programme of a mesenchymal stromal or fibroblast-like cell that builds and maintains tissue architecture and supports the cells embedded in it. CXCL12 is the chemokine by which such stroma recruits and retains haematopoietic progenitors and lymphocytes, while IGF1 with its carrier IGFBP3 sets local growth-factor availability, FRZB tunes Wnt signalling as a secreted antagonist, and complement component C7 and the secreted nuclease DNASE1L3 contribute to clearance of extracellular debris and immune tone.

[untitled BTM module] These genes sketch a morphogen-driven programme that patterns mesenchymal tissue and steers progenitors toward bone, cartilage, skin and blood-supporting fates.
